sources.title: GitHub - Rohaanrz05/Task-02-Rohaan-Zahid: AI Policy Classification ...
sources.snippet: AI Policy Classification System is a machine learning project that uses NLP, TF-IDF vectorization, Truncated SVD, and the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithm to classify AI policy documents into categories. The project demonstrates data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and prediction using real-world policy data. - Rohaanrz05/Task-02-Rohaan-Zahid
